src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Full-width/full-height uniform lines mark tile boundaries.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def intervals(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for cut in cuts:
            if cut >= start: out.append((start, cut)); start=cut+1
        if start < n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs=intervals(h,sep_rows); cs=intervals(w,sep_cols)
    # Copy the first non-empty tile pattern into every other tile.
    tiles=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
            pat=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
            if any(v != bg for row in pat for v in row): tiles.append((ri,ci,pat))
    if not tiles: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sri,sci,pat=tiles[0]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
            if ri==sri and ci==sci: continue
            if r1-r0 != ph or c1-c0 != pw: continue
            for dr in range(ph):
                for dc in range(pw): out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=pat[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
